text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...*gasp*, haah... ngh.
...H-How... was that, Cafe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All I taught was the discipline to focus and face oneself.
And you... pushed yourself to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Right now...
Behind you, lies a different world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Cafe-san.
I offer you my heartfelt... gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: So that was me all along.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My heart has already journeyed ahead toward 'that place.'
All that's left is for this body to overcome the trial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Shuka Sho.
Kyoto Racecourse was—in an uproar of incredible excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista! It's gotta be Buena Vista!!
Just look at how she ran the Oka Sho and the Yushun Himba!
There's no way she can lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire's looking in top shape too, though...!
We might just witness the Saint's true awakening!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chaan!
Show us that magnificent view---!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Incredible.
Every single one of them is glaring with ambition."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In "The 1st," Buena-san holds overwhelming support...
With this, her streak at the top continues, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san is formidable, but even so...
most still place their faith in Buena-san.
—Fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... I see. What the head of the Overseas Expedition Committee
and frontrunner of the turf, Lady Dream Journey,
came all the way to Kyoto to see was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, huh?
...You're treatin' her pretty seriously, ain'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. For right now, you are about to become
the eye of the storm—the center of an era.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Because you feel the same way...
is why you're here too, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...The Kikuka Sho is next, after all.
I'm just checking it out while I'm at it—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna play it off like I'm embarrassed or anything.
Yeah, I came here to see her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Among all my classmates, she's the absolute prize catch. If I can live up to this fervor—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —She's the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous wave of excitement prickles my skin—
and Buena Vista is likely feeling
an even greater swell of emotion.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Win!
—A fierce battle!!
—A clash of titans!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(――I have to win.
In this heated battle. In this fierce contest of endurance...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Would something like what you ate in Hokkaido be alright?
Would something like what you ate in Hokkaido be alright?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: In Hokkaido...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Since it's Kyoto, how about matcha flavor?
Since it's Kyoto, how about matcha flavor?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Instead, once the race is over... let's eat together, just the two of us, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—A victory reward!
How's that sound?
choice_data_list: …Looks like you're good to go now!
…Looks like you'll be just fine now!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
From here on out, I know I can take it all in head-on.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
So, you see?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Won't you fill my heart
with your expectations, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, I won't hesitate.
...I can run properly."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I give it my all...
I'm strong. Don't you agree?
choice_data_list: Yeah! ...Show me the most breathtaking view imaginable!
Yeah! ...Show me the greatest view ever, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-chaaan!"
"With legs like yours, you're guaranteed to win!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Gooooooo!!"
"Show us a race for the history books!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'm fine now!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you as always for your support!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I have reached the Shuka Sho,
the final leg of the Triple Tiara route.
Today—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent view second to no other race!
I'll deliver it to you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Can you hear my voice?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...! W-What is that?
Is a halo... shining down...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"That place" is right there.
I've made it far enough... to reach out and touch it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And now,
I have a request... for all of you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Look upon me, look up to me... and with all your hearts, I ask you to lift me high."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“—From here on, please entrust...
all of your prayers to me.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Desire-chan. You've worked so, so hard, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I can feel it so clearly. That intense, burning resolve to "see it through to the end"...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Desire-chan.
I wonder if you can feel my feelings too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believes in me.
...There are people waiting to see that breathtaking view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My world is right here and nowhere else.
Everyone's expectations... I will fulfill them!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Ufufu...! 
You truly are... overflowing with light.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now that is a trial bestowed upon me.
Come, let us begin!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am the one who—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll make it there!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Toward that breathtaking view we yearn for!
—Toward the world we are destined to reach!
